mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT I.INQUIRY_NO, I.MEMBER_NO, I.CATEGORY, I.TITLE, I.STATUS, TO_CHAR(I.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(I.ANSWERED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS ANSWERED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY I.CREATED_AT DESC) AS RN FROM INQUIRY I WHERE I.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND I.STATUS != 'D' ) WHERE RN BETWEEN #{offset} + 1 AND #{offset} + #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INQUIRY WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND STATUS != 'D'

SELECT I.INQUIRY_NO, I.MEMBER_NO, I.CATEGORY, I.TITLE, I.CONTENT, I.ANSWER, I.STATUS, TO_CHAR(I.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(I.ANSWERED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS ANSWERED_AT, M.NICKNAME AS MEMBER_NICKNAME, M.EMAIL AS MEMBER_EMAIL FROM INQUIRY I JOIN MEMBER M ON I.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE I.INQUIRY_NO = #{inquiryNo} AND I.STATUS != 'D'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INQUIRY WHERE STATUS != 'D'
AND STATUS = #{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE INQUIRY SET ANSWER = #{answer}, STATUS = 'A', ANSWERED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE INQUIRY_NO = #{inquiryNo} AND STATUS = 'W'
